_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: On a phone, selecting the only changed file again must not offer a next arrow when it has one change. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". Click the row titled "only.txt" in ".diff-rethink-mobile-files". Wait until ".diff-rethink-bottom-change-label" reads "Change 1 of 1" AND there is no ".diff-rethink-next-change" button (the editor has finished loading). Click ".diff-rethink-file-jump" to open the file picker, then click its row titled "only.txt" again. The picker closes, ".diff-rethink-file-position" reads "File 1 of 1", the bottom still reads "Change 1 of 1", and there must still be no ".diff-rethink-next-change" button.
